entries.text: Meeting yedu yataitarisira kuti Tuesday ichapinda ye—yenzvimbo ino iyi, it has been postponed because kwakanyorwa imwe tsamba, hanzi musi wa eighteen May, yekutizvo vanhu vari pano vari kutovaka chechi. It would be a sad day if the application is rejected, but we are looking forward to a happy day, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti application ichadii...? entries.text: Then kune munhu akadonhedza makii aya nezuro, muchechi. Akanhongwa, handizive kuti ndeve... kuda ndivo vaya vaye ve carpentry, handiti, oro vemuno muchechi. So, whichever way, makii akanhongwa muno muchechi nezuro handizive kuti ndeani. Kana kuti pamwe munhu wacho nhasi haana kuuya. Aaaamen. So, we will leave them somewhere convenient. Ma brother o—munhu wose wa—a—anenge akarasa makii oatora, handiti. Haazi epano aya. They mistook them to be these ones. Aya ndanga ndiinawo muhomwe mangu. Saka aya hameno kuti ndeani aya, handiti. entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It's a good chorus, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka when you start playing with friends, then you see a friend playing with a friend that's not very spiritual, you start singing, Shamwari neshamwari... [Apostle chuckles—ED]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Kana ari munhu anorangarira, Mweya waMwari unomuitira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Eh, anobva aziva kuti zvaari kuita handi...? [Congregation says, “handizvo,”] handizvo, obva akanda pasi. “How can two walk together unless they be a...? [Congregation says, ‘agreed,’] agreed.” Handi’munoona, eh. Ve—"Birds of a feather, flock to…? [Congregation says, ‘together,’] together.” Handitika, eh. “And the deep calleth unto the...” [Congregation says, “deep.”] ha’moona.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Hakuna munhu anonwa doro, anotamba nemunhu asinganwi. Vedoro nofodya zvikwata zvavo vo...? [Congregation says, “voga,”] ende vane pavanosangana. Mahure anotamba ari mahure. Handi’ndizvozvo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Eh. Mhombwe dzotambawo dziri chii? [Congregation says “mhombwe.”] Handi’munoona matambiro avanenge vachiita? Mbavha inotambawo nei...? [Congregation says, “nembavha,”] nembavha, handi’muri kuona? Eh?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Saka ukaona munhu akanaka, achitamba nemunhu a—akaipa, it just means kuti munhu iyeye wamuri kufunga kuti akanaka, hamusati mamudii...? [Congregation says, “mamuziva.”] Hamusati maziva zvaari. When you find out what that man is like, muchazoona kuti zvanga zvisingaite kuti vanhu ava vatambe ve...? [Congregation says, “vese,”] vese, handi’munoona? Kana kuti zvanga zvichiita, only that we didn't know the other one, ha’moona?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu wese, tsvaga shamwari ine Mweya waMwari, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] ha’maona? Ma Messages aya, if you go to take time, that's why we took trouble kuaisa pa—paDVD. Now, you can, if you don't have a DVD, kuti urekoderwe [ to record-ED] togona kukurekodera iri audio, ha-maona. Ita ma Messages ako aya, anozokubatsira rimwe gore...? [Congregation says, “gore,”] rimwe gore, handi’munoona eh?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Shamwari inenge isina Mweya waMwari kutaura chokwadi inokuuraya, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] ha’maona. Ndosaka kana pakuroora chaipo chaipo chaipo, Brother Branham, vakati munhu namata kana wakuda kuroora, because the best friend yako kazhinji, it's either your wife or your hu...? your husband, ha’maona. Hanzi namata, because many have ruined their lives, by marrying a wrong pa...? [Congregation says, “partner.”] Mozviziva izvozvo? [Congregation says "Amen."] Eh?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Unoroora unoroora wrong partner, hamumbofi makapindirana, ende hamumbofi makawirirana muhupenyu. Munonetsana che... [Congregation says, “chete,”] chete, ha’maona? Ende, this is one thing that I have realised, maybe it's characteristic ofu [as in ‘of’—ED] young people. Vanonetsana mudzimba dzavo zvisingamboite. Yet ndino-feeler kuti panguva yavanenge vari young, because inini I never had that trouble, pandakanga ndiri mupfanha ndichangoroora. I had been born again! Ndakanga ndabarwa pai...? [Congregation says, “patsva,”] patsva! Saka ndakaroora mukadzi wangu ndiri mupfanha stereki, kuma twenty-six, twenty-seven years, but eh, takawirirana. Zvakanyanya chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But, these days nenyaya yekuti vapfanha vazhinji, vanoteerera zvavanoudza pahushamwari hwani? [Congregation says, “hwavo,”] hwavo. Vanoita bonding ye friendship, yekuti at times, zvinhu zvamunovaparidzira zviya zviya izvi, havazvitore, hm? They don't take it! Vanotora zvavanoudzana ivo vari vezera rimwe...? [Congregation says, “rimwe chete.”] Muri kuona danger inoitika ipapo? Hah? Anotora ma friends anowirirana, ndovanenge vachikanzurana, vachiudzana. Iwe ukamupa advice kuti, “Munhu waMwari, ndiri kukukumbira, dai warega kudai.” He doesn't listen to you. He listens, to his friend, or he listens to his wife, or he listens to her husband, contrary to the revelation yeShoko rani? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Chii chinobuda ipapo?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Now, that's what I got through out, eh muhupenyu hangu. Mukaona pakupasta [to pastor—ED] kwandakaita. Nda’ndichitaurira vanhu vakawanda, kuti ma—va—when most of these eh eh brothers vakazobva paChechi, vakaita sana Brother Musharu, nana Brother Mukodzi, at a very young age, eh, ivo nemadzimai vavo ku—vaine—vainetsana. Handizivi kana mamuchiriko kuKwekwe imi, kwaitiza Sister Musharu vachimbotiza ku flat? [Apostle chuckles—ED] Ha’maona?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Then moona mu—br—Sister Mukodzi vachiti, “Mukodzi is too ha...?” But you see what I used to do? Ndaingouya ndongotaura panapa, ndoparidza ndosiya zvakadaro. But you would find kuti the young man hasn't taken advise yako yawamudii…? [Apostle knocks several times—ED] yawamupa. Neither has the woman taken advise yako yawamupa. At the end of the day look at the end result. Look at the end result.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: At the end result the girl goes to extreme levels, kunodyisa murume. Adyisa murume, once murume adyiswa, pane chicharegwa kuitwa? Woona murume uya ochikwezva manje kubva paChe...? paChechi. Ha’maona? Which I think ka, once mushonga watobata pamunhu, kana imi muChechi macho munenge muchamudii munhu iyeye? Ha’maona zvatooma eh? Once mushonga wabata, what are you going to do with a brother, a—a—a—a—apfuhwiriwa? Muchamudii...? Ha’maona? No matter what you do, anosvika kumba achikiringiwa, achikiringiwa, achikiringiwa, ha’maona?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: It goes back, Mwari havambokupi mukadzi anokuparadza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti Mwari vakati, “The second best what? gift [Congregation says, ‘gift,’] outside of Sal...? [Congregation says, ‘Salvation,’] is what?” [Congregation says, “it's a good wife.”] Kana chiri chokwadi kuti Mwari akapa br— Sister Mukodzi, kuna Brother Mukodzi, Ari Mwari vakazviita, zvino, aizova munhu ayizounza kuguma kwehupenyu hwako? Hamuoni kuti hakuzi kuronga kwaMwari? Hah? Hakuzi kuronga kwaMwari uku. Mwa—Mukadzi waunoti ndapihwa naMwari ndanamata, okuita chituta? Chi zombie? Can that be God? Shamwari neshamwari, dzisinganamate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanhu vapinda muimba vasinganamate handiti?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndo-o the same nevakadzi. Tine vakadzi vakarohwa havasisina meno. Vamwe vane zvirwere, mabayo, mbabvu dzakatyoka. Vamwe vakadzimara vakashakara vakashata, depending nevarume vakavadii...? [Congregation says, “vakavaroora.”] Could that husband have come from God? Can that be a husband from God? [Sister says, “no.”] Ha’maona?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona, handi’moona? Handidi kukunyeperayi vanhu vaMwari, handiti, hapana nyasha dzinodarika kupinda muChechi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapana nyasha dzinodarika kupinda muChechi. Ende hapana wisdom inodarika wisdom iri muKereke yaani? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Hazviite! Ha’maona? Wisdom iri muKereke yaMwari it's unbeatable. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’maona?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ende simba romutendi gurusa ! gurusa ! Simba romutendi, riri mukunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’muri kupanzwisisa ipapo? [Congregation says, “mmm."] Hama ino... Hanzi, “…Gugudza unodii...? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’] tsvaka unoita sei? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,’] kumbira woita sei? [Congregation says, ‘unopihwa,’] Kumbira unopuhwa.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka kunamata vanhu vaMwari tinouya tokushora, ha’maona? It's either we are intellectual, or we feel we are a better class, or we feel we are better than maybe the preacher, that's preaching to us. We feel we are better. But one thing for sure if you were better, you would not even have found yourself in that Church anyway. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heh? You became better in that Church .[Congregation says, “Amen.”] You got all the wisdom in that Church. But hationei mauyiro awakauya wakaita, kwavarara yemunhu.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Pamwe waive mwana wezvikoro. [Apostle claps once—ED] Pamwe waive rovha. [Apostle claps once] Pamwe waive murombo. [Apostle claps once—ED] Pamwe wanga usina kana ma"O", waito korosponda. [to correspond—ED] NdiMwari vakakutungamirira nzira yako yo...? [Congregation says, “yose, Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Vazhinji vedu tinokanganwa kwatakabva! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopanozouya arrogance manje ipapo, handi’moona? Ndosaka mukaona, muChechi Mwari pese paunouya muChechi, Mwari vanenge vane Shoko newe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] MuChechi ndemekuti uregere tumwe tutsika, tunhu tusingakuitire. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukatsiurwa neShoko raMwari, haikona kuita nharo neShoko raMwari. [Sister says, “Amen.”] Haikona kurezista [to resist—ED] kana kurirezinira [to reason—ED] Zvarataura Shoko raMwari, zvinenge zvakanaka, teura! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vakugaidhe [to guide—ED] handi’maona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka muchaona pakati peduka? Handiti? We will continually get surprises, unexpected people, unongovaona vapinda munyika. And good thing that’s why am here, I'll always be here, I believe in time tested what? Faith.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Hatimborambidzi munhu kubva paChechi, paanoda kubva, but tinoda kutarisa gumo yani? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Ini ndo’pandinenge ndakangomira chete. Ini ndinotarisa gumo yemunhu. Right now, I used to tell the brothers tichibva pazvimuchongoyo zviye zva2000, kuti, “Vanhu vaMwari, varume vafurirana ava.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But vanhu vakaitwa intimidated nema numbers ani...? [Congregation says, “avo,”] avo. Ndobva vaitwa intimidated nekuti these are the people who seemed to be pillars in the Church. They seemed to be what? [Congregation says, “pillars.”] and they would be adults in the Church. Ndobva vasimuka, ndokubva vapopota, ndobva vaita chimuchongoyo chavo, ndobva vati, hwaaa one time. But hatichitarisai manje patave iye zvino, tione kuti anganga ari right kubva pakutanga ndi...? [Congregation says, “ndiani?”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Unonodzidzei ukaenda kune hama, vana Brother Vagusiwa, nhasi, unonodzidzei? Unonodzidzei ukaenda kuna hama vana Brother eh, Marisa, nana Brother Manyuchi? Unonodzidzei kunana Katewe? Unonodzidzei kunana Innocent nana Bernard, unonodzidzei? But try and think mazuva avabva vapfanha va— how effective they were kusheka [to shake-ED] kutenda kweva...? [Congregation says, “kwevanhu.”] Hi?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: They were effective zvisingaiti, kusheka kutenda kwevanhu, zvekuti vanhu, vakafunga kuti, paitwa Moove, ende vanhu ndeveMweya. Vachitaura vapfanha vakapfeka ma suit, vakabata ma C.O.D, Volume 1, Volume 2. [Apostle chuckles—ED] Aaa aah ? Pakaitwa Show, ha’moona ? Theatretics dzakaitwa musi iwoyo, ha’maona ?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Vana Marisa vachiuya paChechi vakaisa pfuti umu, vana Muranga, vanga vakapeta maoko kudai vachibva paimba yairenda [to rent—ED] Katewe iya, handi’moona ? Vachiuya paya paya, vachiungana. Vakatanga maservice kwaKatewe kuya kuya uku, imi ! Munhu anenge asina chizaruro manje, handi’moona, zvaiva-affecter. Takauya muChechi medu mukarangarira, taipa ma service tichitarisa pamahwindo kutya kutemwa nematombo.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Hmm, where are those men now? Some are dead, some are backslidden, some are poor, ha’maona? But do you know kuti zvose izvozvo, zviri apparent, vanhu vachiona, we still could get people after that, [Congregation says, “Amen.,”] vanoungana vachi influe-ntsana [to influence—ED] fu...? [Congregation says, “futi.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndopandakabata kuti nyaya ye influence inenge diki, asi inyaya yaparadza vakawanda [Congregation says, “Ameeen!”] Handi’muri kupanzwisisaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Munhu ngaateure. Those spirits never die!! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona? Mweya iyoyo haiiti zvacho...? [Congregation says, “zvachose,”] zvachose.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But hushamwari hwakanaka, ngationei kwatabva. We shouldn't... No matter what happens in life, nothing should remove the fact yekuti takachengetana, tikakudzana, kana kuti na Pastor Chuma ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi vakauya vari mwana muduku. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] He was a boy, vachipfeka kabudura. Now he is a man sitted there. It's priceless what was put in place kuti hama iyi ive zvairi nhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’muri kupanzwisisa vanhu vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But do you know kuti people forget. Ndozvakaita vana Marisa. They forgot!! I don't know whether it's a result yokuti unenge usina revelation ye Message here? Kana kuti unenge usina revelation yemunhu anokuparidzira? Kana kuti hameno zvinenge zvapinda mumusoro mako? Kana kuti mweya wedzinza? [Apostle claps once—ED] Kana kuti [Apostle claps once—ED] shamwari yacho inenge ine simba rakanyanya iine mari? Kana...? [Apostle claps once—ED] Handimbonzwisise kuti chinoitika chii? But what we know, it would be effective to you somehow. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Munhu ngaateurire hushamwari hune Mweya waMwari hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kuita sungano dzinenge dzine mweya yetsvina muka...? [ Congregation says, “mukati.”] Dzokuurayai, ha’maona? Hazvina basa kuti pakanga pachiitikei. Hazvina basa kuti makaudzananei. Hazvina basa kuti makawira muchivi chorudzi rwuyi, ha’moona? Vanhu ngavadzokere vanoita hukama naMwa...? [Apostle claps once—ED; Congregation says, “naMwari.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Now, we have got spiritual deaths, dze thousands and thousands of people, hmmm? Unonyatsoona vanhu vachienda gahena. Ini ndine mupfanha wangu wandinoziva kuti, Brother Innocent vakabvira ku—ku—ku—ku high school kuMbare, vachitamba na Brother Chatima. They were a trio na Johnson Nyangoni. Johnson Nyangoni vaive muraini rimwe chete naChatima kuMbare uku. Nyangoni backslid, ndobva kwasara Innocent naChatima.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Brother vano—vakarwisana. Innocent achitora chechi. Chatima achitorera Innocent che—chechi, handiti? But how come they are together today? [Apostle chuckles—ED] Mukuona kune imwe mweya yegahena imwe yekutika [Apostle chuckles—ED] unoshaya kuti haaah! Inosevenza sei? They will be together in everything.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Vanotukana, vanorovana, vanotorerana makereke, vagodhinawutsana [to denounce—ED] but unongovaona vari vese. [Apostle claps once—] Igahena riya. Ende ukachizotarisa manje pahuviri hwavo kutamba kwavo kwacho, kuti unyatsoona kuti kwavavakire chii? Handiti? Muri kuona kuti iye zvino hushamwari hwavo hwakasvika pakunovafurirana kuti umwe atore mwana wake mukomana, umwe atore mwana wake musikana varoodzane? [Apostle claps hands once—ED] Huh! Against better judgement!!! Mweya yetsvina zvainoita vanhu vaMwari yakaipa!! Mweya yetsvina! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inouraya vanhu zvisingadii...? [Congregation says, “zvisingaiti.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka iwe neni nhasi uno, manheru ano, kuteura kwakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanhu vane mweya yetsvina vakagara vasingaoni zvakanaka zvavanoitirwa havaperi. Ndosaka muchiona munhu unotora munhu anga abamura Chechi, momudzora paKereke, momuti huyai tinamate tese. But that brother haachinje hunhu hwake. Haachinje kukurwisai kwaari kuita. Haachinje kuda kuhedhutsa vanhu vaanenge achiona vari weak mukuna...? [Congregation says, “mukunamata.”] Moshaya kuti hindava? Now, ndoda kukutaurirai chokwadi, those people you will never know about them. Munotongonamata nani? [Congregation says, “navo.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Whether mukadzi nemurume, [Apostle claps once—ED] you will never know about them. Whether there are two brothers like that, [Apostle claps once—ED] you never know about. Until zuva ravanofurirwa naMwa... ravanofumurwa naMwari. Hamufe makavaziva. Miriam uyu, akaita mweya wakaipa achitamba naCharity uyu, hamumbofe makavafumura. Vanoramba vachingovanda chete chete. Anozopedza navo ndiMwari, nokuti gumo yavo inenge yakashata chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’muri kuona kuipa kwenyaya yacho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Mukaona Witness uyu, atamba ipapapa kana kuti na Silas apa, hamumbofi makavafumura. Vanenge vachingonzwisisana, vachitsanangurirana, vachibatana nehuchenjeri, vachitaurirana nyaya dzavo. Hamufe makavagona.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Akava mudzimai nomurume, it's a worse, eh, setup. Anozongogona kufumura vanhu ivavo igumo yevanhu ivavo neMweya waMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Now, hatitarisei ku side iroro reshamwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nezuro takaona vana Zadok. Tikaona vana Hushai. Tikaona vana Abiathar. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona kuti chikwata chatakaona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Nhasi hatitarisei rutivi irwo...? [Congregation says, “irworwo,”] rweava. Handei kuna—Samere yedu. Handei kuna 1st Samuel yedu. 2nd Samuel. Handei kuna Chapter 16. Tasvika kuna 2nd Samuel Chapter 16? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitii Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen”] Hatitangei pa verse 1, tinyatsoona. Handei pa verse 1 tione: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Mamuona Ziba uyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iservant ya Mephibosheth. Mephibosheth ndiani? Mwana wa Saul. Wamhanya. Kirikiri, “Ndauya, ndauya, ndauya, ndauya, ndauya. Ndinemi mambo. Waini he-e. Ndakamira nemi.’ Inzwai mashoko ake. Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei pa verse 2 tione: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said; The asses be for the king's household to ride on; the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuona zvaari kutaura? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kutsvaga hubhururuka uku, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitarirei tione pa next apa, verse 3. Hativerengei verse 3: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said. To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuona mashoko aya. [Apostle chuckles] Hanzi Mephibosheth watosara kumba. Ari kufara nenyaya iyi. Ari kuti izvo, “Aaah, handi’makatorera baba vake Saul hushe? Nhasi mamukirwa nemwana we...?” [Congregation says, “wenyu.”] Ari kuti, “Handikuteerei.” “Asi inini ndauya mambo, ndimi vandinoda, ndimi wandinoremekedza. Ndimi mambo wangu chai…?” [Congregation says, “chaiye.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Handei mberi tione. Verse 4 tese: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kupaona ipapo. Muri kupaona here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mambo vamupa zvinhu zvaMephibosheth zve…? [Congregation says, “zvese.”] Zvikanzi, “Ini chandinongoda, ndoda nyasha pamaziso enyu.” [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] Nyaya idzika idzi, haumbofa wakadziwana solution yadzo. Handei pane next one muone. Here is another one again. Verse 5. Handei pana verse 5, tione mese: And when David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuona chimwe chauya ichi ? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiri kutukiriraka ichi? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Uyu ari kuuya achitsvaga favour uyu. Uyu wa Shimei uyu ari kuuya achidiiwo? [Congregation says, “achitukirira.”] Mambo vari weak ka apa? Vari pa weakest point yani? [Congregation says, “yavo.”] Handei tione. verse yaaah, eh, 6 tese: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left. Verse 7: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial: [Apostle Gumbura laughs]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Saka nyaya yekutukwa iyi yakabvira ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Eh, “Iti Gumbura inguruve,” zvakangogara zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakadaro. “] Uyu akatotukwa vanhu vose vari…? [Congregation says, “varipo.”] “Murume azere neropa, zibenzi romunhu! Haaa! Berial [as in Belial-ED] wemunhu! Mhondi!” Achitema nematombo, achikanda jecha, achitema nematombo, achikanda jecha. Chaka-performer chirume ichi.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: “Haah? Chii ichocho chawakaita? Zvino hona oooh! Handi’wakatora imba yaba—hushe hwababa vangu, hweimba yaSauro, ukafunga kuti iwewe wagona? Zvino nhasi uripi? Hezvo womukirwa nomwana! Mwana wokubereka. Zimbwa romunhu! Zibenzi!”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Haa, kwakatukiwa munhu semunhu. Hm? Shaudhi isingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaite.”] Handei mberi muone. Right, verse 8 tese. The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son; and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Now, chandoda kuti mubate, ndinoda kuti munhu wese aite Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda kuti munhu wese ati, Ameni varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda kuti muone chinhu one. Pese panowira vanhu vaMwari mudambudziko, interpretation dzinosiya…? [Congregation says, “dzinosiyana, Amen/Hallelujah.”] Handi’muri kupabata ipapo vanhu vaMwari? [ Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi ndikaita car accident izvezvizvi, moziva kuti munhu wese wechibenga anoti kuchii? “Bloody man, Mwari vazomudii…?” [Congregation says, “vazomutsiura.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But zvinenge zviri izvozvo? Muri kupaona? One thing chandoda kuti muzive ndechokuti, “Mwari, havafe vakarasa vanhu vavo.” [Congregation says, “Hallelujah/Amen.”] Izvozvo hazviiti izvozvo. Hanzi, “Ndinewe kusvika kumagumo enyi…?” [Congregation says, “enyika.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Kufunga kwako uku. Ha’ maona. Ndosaka iwe ndiwe unoto…? “Hee-ee nhasi…” Zvikanzi, “Brother Gumbu…?”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Makanganwa kuti patakafirwa nomwana eh, kuti nyika yose yakati kudii tichifirwa naZane? Hanzi ndiani atitsiura? NdiMwari. Toita car accident ye-ye family, yaita car accident, zvikanzi ndiMwari ari kutsiura. Handizivi kuti zvinonditsiura chii izvozvo ? Mukuona kuti i—interpretation dzevanhu ? Imimi vatsvene nhasi, hatikurei pamweya. [Congregation says, “Hallelujah/Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Kune vanhu vanofunga zviri very simple. Kana kune makuti zuva risingabudi, hanzi Mwari vakadii…? [Congregation says, “Vakatsamwa.”] Vakatsamwa. Kana kune zuva richinyatsodziya richi… [Inaudible 0:28:14.5] hanzi nhasi Mwari vari kusekerera. Ndozvazvinoreva? Ndo interpretation yakafanana neiyi. Hatitarisei kwabva munhu naMwari wake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Munoziva here kuti kunyangwe tichinamata Mwari zvakanaka, tinowirwawo netsaona rimwe zu…? [Congregation says, “rimwe zuva/Amen.”] Mumwe musiwo tinorwarirwawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndohupenyu. That’s what life is all a…? [Congregation says, “about.”] But, ngatiregerei kuti pese patawirwa nechinhu, inyaya yekuti pane chivi. Inyaya yekuti pane chakanganisika. Zvino weakener vanhu kunamata zviya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende zvino divider va…? [Congregation says, “vanhu.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Vamwe vanotongwa nehope dzavo. Hope dzake dzikamuratidza kuti zvaarota ndizvo, uri muporofita iwe? Ko, kana kurota kwako kuri kuguta? [Congregation laughs—ED] Munhu wese ngaagamuchire kuti hope dzinogona kupotsa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hope dzinogona kutaura. Dai hope dzaive chokwadi nguva dzose, ndiani asina kuzvirota achibhururuka? [Congregation laughs] Munhu wese akatomborota achibhururuka one day. Ndobva wazo…?... koyedza ukabhururuka. [Congregation laughs—ED] Vana vaMwari ngatidzidze! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitii Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akapfuura ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! Handei mberi tione. Verse 9 tese. Verse 9 tese: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Handei mberi tione: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so? Verse 11 tese: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? Let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him Verse 12: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kupaona ipapo? Verse 13: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kupaona apa? He-eyi. Vanhu vanoita zvavanoda. Now, toda kutarisa vanhu ava. Handitika ? Hatichiendai kuna Samuel Chapter 19. Takatarisa vanhu ivava chete. Ndovatiinavo. Tasvika here pana 2nd Samuel Chapter 19? [Congregation say, “Amen.”] Handei paverse ya15, hatiti Ameni tese kana tasvika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tasvika tese paverse ya15? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right, hativerengei verse 15 tione tese: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuona zvakaitika apa? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Right, verse 16: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles/laughs—ED] Mamuonaka murume uyu? Wanga achikanda maii? [Congregation says, “matombo.”] Matombo nejecha achituka kuti, “Hushe huye hwadzokera kumba kwedu manje. Zvino hona zvawaita iwewe, you bloody man.” But, ndiye ari kutanga kuuya. Chinzwai mashoko ake, hm? Handei muone verse 17 tese, handei tione: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kupaona apa? Right, handei mberi verse 18: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan; And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart. Hee-heee. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuvaona vanhu ve type iyi? Vanogara vari…? [Congregation says, “variko.”] “Musakanganwe, musarangarira zviya zvandakaita pachimuchongoyo, wakanga uri mweya wetsvina. Ndakadzidza! Zvinhu zvakafanana naizvozvo handichadzokorora zvaka…?” [Congregation says, “zvakare.”] “Izvozvo handiiti!!! Uya wakanga uri mweya wekushata uya uya! Ndanyatsotendeuka. Nda’a mwana waMwari!!! Ingondidzorerai muKereke vanhu vaMwari ndinamate.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Anotanga kuruma vanhu one by one… [Congregation says, “one,”] muChechi imomo, achivadzosera munyi…? [Congregation says, “munyika.”] Hazvina basa kuti munomuitirei. Hazvina basa kuti munomubatsira neipi yenzira. Munhu ane mweya wetsvina hazvizi musimba rake, mweya uri maa…? [Congregation says, “maari.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Handei mberi tione. Verse 20, hativerengei tose verse 20, ndoda Ameni munhu wese! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiti Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 20 hativerengei: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Heee-heee. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Muri kuvaona varume ava? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanouya… Ndosaka vazhinji venyu, mukaona tichidzora vanhu, tichidzora paChechi, handitika, [Congregation says, “ummm,”] vakaita zvinhu zviri very atrocious. Hakusi kuti hatizivi kuti pamwe mweya hauna kusanduka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Kutya Mwari ndokuvamba kwei…?” [Congregation says, “kwezivo! Amen.”] Te’tichiziva Shoko raMwari. Saka te’tichiziva kuti neimwe yenguva, zvakadaro zvakaitika, ende vanhu vaMwari vakaita sei panguva iyoyo! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Ndomutsara wamunofanira kuti muto…? [Congregation says, “mutore.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndopamunoona munhu wese kunyangwe ari wechibenga, kunyangwe akadii, akauya akati, “Ndoda kutendeuka,” handitika? Tomuti, “Dzokera mui…?” [Congregation says, “muChechi,”] Nokuti ndiyo pattern yeShoko raani? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Vamwe brother munovaziva nokuti vanonetsa, vanotuka, vanopopota, vanotsvinya. Vanoita zvinhu zvisina basa rose but unomupa nguva yake, nokuti hakuna munhu anokunda Mwari! [Congregation says, “Hallelujah.”] Aaaameeen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi tione. Verse 21, hativerengei tose: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’S anointed?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: “Munhu ngaaurawe uyu.” Moona zvinoitika muChechi? “Haaa vakomana, mati vadzoke here vakuru ava? Isu hatigone kutambirana navo, haaa, vanonetsa. Unonzwa kana kuremerwa kana vari kugotsi kwako.” [ Congregation laughs; Apostle chuckles—ED]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Handi’munoona zvinenge zvichiita vanhu? Handiti? Zvakagara zvakadaro kubvira ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Heh? Hatinzwei kuti Dhavhidhi akati kudii? Verse 22 tese: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? Shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? For do not I know that I am this day king over Israel? Verse 23: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kupabataka apa varanda vaMwari ? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’maona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then, kwakanga kune guhwa rakanga rauya kudhara pamusoro pa Mephibosheth, uyu atoregererwa uyu. “Haafi murume uyu, muregerei apinde.” Ha’maona zvandinoita nguva nenguva vanhu vaMwari ? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haikona kuita zvinhu zvisina pattern yeShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanhu vanogona kukuudza voti, “Aiwa aiwa, hatingamutambire murume uyu, hatingamutambire.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But mukaona munhu atendeuka amira pamberi penyu, muregerei aratidze ma colours ani ? [Congregation says, “ake,”] ake. “Garai munhu waMwari. Hanti mati matendeuka ? Eh, pindai muChechi mugare.” Haikona kudzinga munhu, paChechi, but mweya ucha-manifester wega, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] panguva yakadii… ? [Congregation says, “yakafanira.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona zviya tichiparidza pamusoro pekuti vanhu paChechi, paChechi, paChechi. Takagara munomu, musafunga kuti we are stupid enough to think that everybody is hundred percent with us. Musafunge kuti tiri kufunga kuti everybody ari kuenda kumba kwake achitaura good about us. Musafunga kuti tiri kufunga kuti pese pamunouya ku service muri kuuya mose nomwoyo unoda, makasununguka muchiuya muChechi. We know!!! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “People die; spirits don’t die!!!” [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Te’tichizviziva nguva nenguva.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka iwe ugere ipapo, unenge uchifunga kuti, “Aaah, pastor havambotibati isu, havambotizivi. Haaa, ndezvavo zvavanenge vachitaura zviya zviyazvi.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Tingadei tisina kurarama all these years tiri vafundisi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingadei tisina kuropafadzwa kusvika patakadii…? [Congregation says, “patakasvika.”] Eh. Vamwe vanenge vachikudaro unenge uchitovachengeta ndiwe. Ungadei uchiiwana kupi wisdom yekuvachengeta dai Mwari akanga asina kukupa nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] Ha’moona zvinoitika muhupenyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Mwari vakanaka kune vanovadana paZita Ravooo! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Eeeh! Ndosaka haikona kufa wakaita zimweya rakashata kudaro. Ha’maona. Iwe unenge uchifunga kuti handisi kuzivikanwa. Unofunga kuti handizi kuonekwa. Unofunga kuti pamwe havafe vakandi-discover. Who told you that we should discover you? Who told you that! Who told you that we should expose you and chase you away?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Dhavidhi, Shimei aimuzivaka uyu? Vana Abishai vese vaimuzivaka Shimei uyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But akati ngaauraiwe here? Zvikanzi, “Aiwa muregei. Eh. Ndaitwa mambo nhasi muIsraeri musiyeyi. Muregerei adzoke. Pinda munamate shamwari, Amen.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Tarira Mephibosheth uya. Mephibosheth ndokureverwa nhema. [Apostle chuckle—EDs] Handiti? Kana kuti chokwadi chakamhangarwa na Zi…? Na Ziba, handitika? Eh?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe uri-uri upi? Iwe uri upi? Uri weAmeni here iwe muChechi usi…? [Congregation says, “usimo.”/Apostle chuckles] Iwe uri wezino irema hereee!!! Heh. Uri wezino irema? Uri wewuye wekuti haugadziri? Uri upi? Iwe zvako uno…? Ndimi here vaye vokubva, motaura nyaya dzenyu, but kuChechi modzo…? [Congregation says, “modzoka.”] Are you conspirators?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Muri kuoona kuti umwe noumwe anenge ane chikwata chake chaari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iwe chikwata chako ndechipi? [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] “…Vane nzeve dzokunzwa ngavanzwe-e!” [Congregation says, “Amen/Hallelujah.”] Iti, “Ini ndiri Zadok.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ini ndiri Abiathar.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Ini ndiri A- Hushai.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Hatiti Amen akadarika Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kupabata here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatinzwei Mephibosheth kuti ari papi, Mephibosheth? Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Handei kunaMephi… verse 24 tese, verse 24 tese. Hatiti Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei Mephibosheth tese: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Eh. Tongai-i manheru anhasi, handitika? [Apostle laughs] Heee. Hama yaka… Haina kugeza. Ha’maona zviri apa? Haina kugeza, haina kukama [ to comb hair-ED] nokuti ndomukomana uya uya akanga ari crippled. Akabva anzi na—a na—a…? Anga ari mwana waJonathan. Akabva anzi na—a Dhavidhi, “For thy father’s what? [Congregation says, “sake,”] sake. Huya udye patafura yaani? [Congregation says, “yangu”] Zvehondo zvadii…?” [Congregation says, “zvapera.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But musi wawira Brother Dhavhidhi munhamo, akunzi ari kuti, “Hushe huya hwadzokera kumba kwaSau…?” [Congregation says, “kwaSaul.”] Hah! Now, chinzwai mashoko ake iye. Chinzwai mashoko ake. Hemen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 25 ngativerengei: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest now thou with me, Mephibosheth?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: “Uri kuuya nhasi, but patakanga tichibuda pano hauna kuuya. Kwakauya muranda wako Zi…? [Congregation, “Ziba.”] Ko iwewe hindava usina kubuda neni? Sei usina kubuda neni?” Ndoda kuti mutongewo nhasi manheru anhasi [Apostle chuckles—ED, Congregation laughs] Amen!! Handika? Eh? Toda kuti mutonge mose manheru anhasi. Verse 26 ngativerengei tese: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: “Ndiri chirema. Ndakanga ndati, ‘shamwari chindigadziriraka dhongi ndiwane kumhanya ndiende kunani? [Congregation says “kuna mambo”] kuna mambo.’ Bhururu wangu, muranda wangu Ziba uyu, ndokunditso…!” [Apostle claps his hands once—ED; Congregation says, “ndokunditsotsa.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Unoitonga sei uri iwe? [Apostle laughs] Muri kuona, akatsotsewa here murume uyu? Ini handifungi kuti akatsotsewa. [Congregation laughs—ED] Ziba akanyeba? Handifungi kuti Ziba akanyepa. Muri kupabata here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitoziviwo!

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Now, those kind of mysterious loyal people paChechi vanogara vari…? [Congregation says, “varipo.”] Vanotaurwa zvakashata kunzi, “Anga achikunyeya.” But ukamu…? “No, pastor handina kumbodii…? [Congregation says, “kuzvitaura.”] Ava varume ava, vaiti, ‘zvakati zvakati, zvakati, zvakati,’ ini ndabva ndanyarara. I didn’t comment. Haaa. Kundi-framer kwavari kudii uku?” [Congregation says, “kwavari kuita.”] Unoita sei?

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Brother nhingi nabrother nhingi, vaive mabest friends nabrother nhingi. Ivo brother nhingi havambouyi kukuudza kuti, “Hongu ndanga ndiri, kana kuti ndanga ndisiri.” Vanongoshumira havo, vakadii…? [Congregation says, “vakanyarara.”] But hama dzichiti, “Mmm, ndofunga hama yanga iri, neck deep… [Inaudible 0:42:33.3] nyasha dzatofamba apa.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Murume wakanga angourawa kare nou…? Moziva ndozvinoitika paChechi? Ini nde’ndisingazvizivika. Ko, ndinoswera kunenge kune hama? Kumabasa nde’ndisikoka, handizvizive. Handizive kwamunokwidzana mota. Handizive kwamunoswera. Handizive zvamunotaurirana kana muri mudzimba dzenyu, muchinwa makapu echii…? Etii. [cup of tea—ED] Hatizivi zvaunotaurirana nomudzimai wako, kana nomurume wako. Handina zvandinoziva. Ini ndinongoona vanhu vakagara muChechi vachiita Ameni Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Tikati ngativakei, tinovaka tose. Ukavhura Tithes Box, chegumi chake chirimo. Mukati handei kumunda kunosu—kunokohwa, tinokohwa tese. But mweya waainawo unouziva here? Zvakagara zvakadaro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Zvinhu izvozvo zvinoiswa pamberi paani? [Congregation says, “paMwari.”] Ingoisa nyaya idzi pamberi paMwari.

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndosaka tiri muno, mangwana tiri kupinda mumuteuro vana vaMwari. Tanga tichitora ma series eFriendship, hatirangarirei kuti, “Mwari nditungamirirei pasarudzo yeshamwari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari nditungamirei pasarudzo yesha…?” [ Congregation says, “yeshamwari.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Kune dzimwe shamwari brother dzingori rebellious. Havadi kuvaka Chechi nevamwe. Pama contribution unoona achingo-complainer, “Haaa, haiwa dai zvaitwaso.” Anoda kuti zvinhu… ungati mukaita zvaarikuda, then ano-participator. Ndazvazviri brother eeeh, hama Chiparaushe. Waimboti, “Izvozvo hatisi kuda kuti tiite.”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: But makuchiti, “Ngatichibvisaika tichiite zvacho zvauri kuda kuti tiite.” Haadii futi? Haaiti futi. He’ll be the last kubvisa contribution whether dzebuilding fund or dzechii? Atoona kuti ndasara ndangova nde…? ndega. Saka ndakuzobuda pachena zvadiri. Woona wobva auya, “Pastor.” “Haa haa. Ko, wanga wakanyararirei? Why!”

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ha’moona? Ndosaka mukaona vanhu vaMwari, kunamata, “Kutya Mwari, ndiko kuvamba kwezivo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haufe wakaziva vanhu nokuvatarisa huso hwani? [Congregation says, “hwavo.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Ndopanouya nyaya yemuteuro kuvanasikana, ndopanouya nyaya yemuteuro kuvanakomana. Kana uchida kuroora across this place, handitika, haikona kutarisa face yemwana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Teura! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Friendship Associations And Influences
entries.text: Haikona kuchiva, kuda kungoenda kunozadzikisa chenya…? [Congregation says, “chenyama.”] Ndovakare vanozokupinzai muguva, an early grave, akasara akaraiza [to raise-ED] vana ari o…? [Congregation says, “oga.”] Hanzvadzi iri kuda kuroorwa!!! Iri kuda Mweya waMwari, hanzvadzi inoda Mweya waMwari uno mutungamirira mumba! Ari kuda murume, rega kui- Transcribed by Str Mai Ella.
